regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the source title and current total-synthesis claims. The abstract's 14–17-step statement is route-level evidence, not a single reaction yield.

regions.region: page 1 Figure 1 natural-product structures and biological-activity prose
regions.finding: Figure 1 is a structure/context panel for cyclopiane natural products and contains no reaction arrow or present-paper experiment. Isolation/bioactivity citations are prior literature and were not promoted to current experiments.

regions.region: page 1 prior total-synthesis, biosynthesis, and Danheiser-literature discussion
regions.finding: The Tu, Snyder, biosynthesis, and historical Danheiser references are prior work. The current generic Danheiser design and retrosynthetic plan continue in Figure 2 and are classified separately from forward experiments.

unresolved: Figure 1 and the introductory generic/prior structures do not supply experiment-specific quantities.
The publisher's Supporting Information link does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.finding: Classified Figure 2A as a generic Danheiser-annulation design and Figure 2B as retrosynthetic analysis. Neither retrosynthetic/generic arrow was assigned a current experiment yield.

regions.region: page 2 left-column forward-synthesis prose from 18 through 16
regions.finding: Mapped the CBS reduction, two-step 19→20 sequence, HAT cyclization, three failed alpha-hydroxylation methods, Rubottom oxidation, Grignard addition, cleavage/Luche reduction, Grieco olefination, and tandem Nicholas/Pauson–Khand sequence to separate evidence-linked records. The 20→21 prose yield is 74% and conflicts with Scheme 1's 94%; both are retained.

regions.region: page 2 right-column Danheiser comparison and deoxygenation prose
regions.finding: Recorded independent 15a/15b/15c Danheiser comparison experiments, the preparative one-pot 16→25 sequence, direct 37% Wolff–Kishner result, four ineffective tosylhydrazone reducing-agent trials, and the successful three-step Barton–McCombie sequence. Desired and Sakurai byproduct yields remain separately targeted.
Linked ozonolysis of 14 to keto aldehyde 13 and immediate use in the subsequent aldol stage to the telescoped Scheme 1 n/Table 1 entry 9 record; no duplicate was created.

unresolved: Main-text prose often omits absolute scale, time, workup, purification, and yield basis.
Yield conflict for 20→21 remains unresolved: prose 74% versus Scheme 1 94%.
The modified Wolff–Kishner trials are described only as ineffective, without numerical yields or conditions.

regions.region: page 3 upper and middle Scheme 1 arrows a–q and complete reagent/condition caption
regions.finding: Visually inspected every arrow and caption item. Recorded each isolated endpoint/condition as an independent record, preserved ordered low-temperature additions, untimed warming transitions, reflux stages, all equivalents/loadings, multi-step overall yields, product-targeted yields/selectivities, and the 20→21 94% scheme value alongside the conflicting prose value.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Figure 3 Danheiser comparison, transition-state drawings, and X-ray panel
regions.finding: Recorded three distinct 15a/15b/15c comparison experiments: 28a 91%/29a 0%, 28b 33%/29b 46%, and 28c 89%/29c <5%. TS-A/TS-B are proposed conformations and ent-30 is characterization support, not additional preparations.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right aldol/isomerization and final-product prose
regions.finding: Merged the p-TsOH/26 and 3 M HCl/3+26 prose with matching table/scheme experiments; recorded RhCl3 microwave isomerization, epoxidation, SmI2 reduction, and L-selectride reduction as distinct runs.

unresolved: Most Scheme 1 arrows omit absolute scale, solvent volume, reaction time, workup, purification, isolated mass, or measurement basis.
Timed warming durations are not printed and remain null/missing.
The X-ray structure of ent-30 does not establish a preparation record or machine structure verification.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1–9, columns, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all nine aldol-condition rows independently, merging entry 6 with matching prose and entry 9 with the telescoped Scheme 1 n experiment. Preserved every 3/31/26/32 yield, 24% recovered 13/13′, four-diastereomer footnote, HCl concentration, time, temperature program, and dash marker semantics without converting dashes to zero.
Recorded the 14-step, 4.7% overall route from 18 to conidiogenone B as a route-level outcome, not a final-stage yield. The remaining paragraph summarizes already-recorded transformations.
Administrative and bibliography/prior-literature material only. External cited experiments were not imported as experiments of the current article.

unresolved: Table 1 omits reagent amounts, solvent volumes, most times, workups, purifications, masses, and analytical/yield bases.
Table 1 dashes remain source markers because the paper does not define them as zero or not detected.
For entry 9/Scheme n, the yield denominator is ambiguous between isolated 13 and the telescoped sequence from 14.

regions.finding: The original rendered page contains bibliography and publication metadata only. It has no current-paper reaction arrow, table, experimental procedure, reagent quantity, condition, outcome, failure, mechanism figure, or compound-specific characterization mapping; external cited experiments were not imported.
